description: Most people want access to new rooms in life without understanding the formula that unlocks them. Learn how you think. How you decide. How you regulate. That’s how doors open internally first. #SelfMastery #PersonalGrowth #LeadershipMindset #InnerWork #designyourlife
transcript: It is so important to understand your formula and how to gain access to those parts of you in your internal world that you don't always tap into. The more that I have gained understanding in my formula, I understand what doors require keys. I understand what doors require combination locks, and I know how to get entrance and access to those. I am not worried about others' performances. I am not worried about what others are doing and what others are seeing, because I get that what works for others may not work for me, and that's okay. My life has been created specifically for me. So, of course, what other people are doing may not work for me, and it is my responsibility to tap into that. It's my responsibility to figure me out. It is not anyone else's responsibility to tell me who I am.
